name: Abbest
areas: Spring Meadows, Flying Waters, The Monolith
note: A robed caster Nevron that appears from the early game onward. It resists Physical, so a purely physical party loses a large share of its damage against it.

name: Aberration
note: No elemental weakness and a Dark resistance. One of the enemies that is simply a damage race rather than a puzzle.

name: Ballet
note: The dancers that accompany Sirene, and the vector for her Charm. In the Sirene fight they appear on their own turn and have to be cleared or avoided.

name: Benisseur
note: Shares the Ballet's profile, which makes it one of several enemies covered by a single Ice or Dark party setup.

name: Boucheclier
note: The base form of one of the three Visages masks. Its Chromatic variant is fought as a Vale boss before Mask Keeper.

name: Braseleur
note: Absorbs Fire outright, so any Fire skill used on it heals it. Ice is the answer.

name: Bruler
note: A straightforward early melee Nevron. Lightning lands and nothing in its profile resists you.

name: Catapult Sakapatate
note: One of the Sakapatate family of planted enemies. Fire is the family answer and defeating this one awards Trebuchim.

name: Ceramic Chevaliere
weak: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Dark, Light
note: Weak to six of the available elements. It is effectively element-agnostic - bring whatever your strongest skill happens to use.

name: Chalier
note: Part of the Chalier and Chapelier pairing. Light lands, Dark is resisted, which rules out a Dark-focused Sciel build.

name: Chapelier
note: The base form of the Sorrowful Chapelier mask in Visages. It appears on its own near The Crows.

name: Chorale
note: A singing Nevron of the Sirene area. Killing any Chorale is how you obtain the Colim focus for Lune.

name: Clair
note: Half of the Clair and Obscur pair. It is immune to Light and weak to Dark - the exact inverse of Obscur.

name: Contorsionniste
note: Shares the Fire and Dark profile of the other Visages-area Nevrons.

name: Cruler
note: An ordinary Flying Waters enemy with a clean Lightning weakness.

name: Danseuse
weak: Fire in Ice Stance, Ice in Fire Stance
absorbs: Fire in Fire Stance, Ice in Ice Stance
note: Stance-dependent like Stalact: it absorbs whichever element it is currently in. Check the stance before spending a turn.

name: Demineur
note: A passive Nevron tied to a side quest. Returning an Intact Mine to it is how you receive Deminerim.

name: Echassier
note: A stilt-legged Nevron. Fire lands and nothing is resisted.

name: Gault
note: Three elements matter: Fire lands, Ice and Lightning are resisted, Earth heals it.

name: Glaise
note: The base form of the Glaise boss. Earth is absorbed, which is the trap most players fall into first.

name: Gold Chevaliere
note: The gold-armoured Chevaliere. Its Chromatic form drops Chevalam.

name: Greatsword Cultist
note: Dark is the only element that lands, and its Chromatic form drops Sireso.

name: Hexga
note: An ice-bodied Nevron. Ice is the weakness and Fire is resisted, the reverse of what its appearance suggests.

name: Lancelier
note: An early lance Nevron. Defeating one is the route to Lanceram.

name: Lumiere Citizen
resists: Fire and Lightning (rapiers), Ice and Earth (gun or sword)
note: Its resistances depend on which weapon it is holding, so the correct answer changes mid-fight.

name: Luster
note: Its Chromatic form drops Litheson and is fought in the Forgotten Battlefield.

name: Moissonneuse
note: The base form of Jovial Moissonneuse, one of the three Visages masks.

name: Noire
note: Absorbs Dark and is weak to Light, the mirror of Clair.

name: Obscur
note: Immune to Dark and weak to Light, the inverse of Clair. The pair share a boss form, the Clair Obscur.

name: Orphelin
note: Earth is the one element that lands. Its Chromatic form is the route to Kralim.

name: Pelerin
note: Absorbs Ice, so an ice-based Lune build is a liability against it.

name: Petank
note: No elemental profile. Like the Mime it is excluded from the weakness charts because there is nothing to exploit.

name: Portier
note: An early gatekeeper Nevron with a clean Ice weakness.

name: Potier
note: No weakness and no resistances. Its Chromatic cousin drops Potierim.

name: Ramasseur
note: Light lands and Dark is resisted, the same pairing as Chalier and Troubadour.

name: Ranger Sakapatate
note: A ranged Sakapatate. Fire lands and Lightning is resisted.

name: Reaper Cultist
note: Dark is the only element that lands. Its Chromatic form drops Blodam.

name: Robust Sakapatate
note: The heavy Sakapatate variant. Defeating one awards Sakaram.

name: Rocher
note: A rock-bodied Nevron. Ice lands and Fire is resisted.

name: Sapling
note: One of the most defensive profiles in the game: four elements resisted and Dark absorbed. Light is the only clean answer.

name: Steel Chevaliere
note: Weak to Physical rather than to an element, which makes it one of the few enemies where a physical build is the correct specialist answer.

name: Troubadour
note: Light lands and Dark is resisted. Its Chromatic form drops Troubadim.

name: Veilleur
note: Two elements land and Dark is resisted, so Sciel's Dark kit is the wrong pick.

name: Volester
note: A flying early Nevron with a clean Ice weakness.
